pages.title: Essence Charcoal & Fuels
pages.text: The Alchemy Furnace accepts any burnable item as fuel, but different Essence Charcoals provide different $(bold)speed multipliers$(), greatly reducing crafting time.$(br2)Normal fuels (coal, charcoal, etc.) have a 1.0x speed multiplier, providing only base crafting speed.$(br2)Below are the speed bonuses for each type:

pages.title: Speed Overview
pages.text: Cooking progress currently advances at an integer speed, discarding decimal portions. Effective defaults are:$(li)$(bold)Mud Essence Charcoal$() — $(#090)1x$()$(li)$(bold)Yellow Essence Charcoal$() — $(#990)1x$()$(li)$(bold)Black Essence Charcoal$() — $(#666)1x$()$(li)$(bold)Void Essence Charcoal$() — $(#909)2x$()$(li)$(bold)Prime Essence Charcoal$() — $(#f60)5x$()$(li)$(bold)Explosive Crystal$() — $(#f00)10x$()$(br2)Prime Essence Charcoal reduces a 30-minute Foundation Building Pill to about 6 minutes. Configure values in mortal_cultivation-alchemy_furnace.toml.
